APARTAMENT 2+1+2 PER SHITJE NE PORCELAN
Ekskluzive!
Ne zonen e Porcelanit te Gotech ofrohet apartament 2+1+2 per shitje.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3 te nje ndertimi te vitit 2022 me ashensor dhe te mireadministruar.
Sip. totale e apartamentit eshte 102 m2 dhe organizohet ne: korridor, dy dhoma gjumi, sallon ndenje me ambient gatimi, dy tualete,, ballkon. Orientimi i apartamentit eshte lindje.
Prona shitet e mobiluar si ne foto dhe eshte mundesi ideale si per banim ashtu eshte per investim.
Mundesi blerje per dy poste parkimi me cmim extra.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Per me shume informacion ose shoqerim ne prone lutemi te na kontaktoni.
description_en: APARTMENT 2+1+2 FOR SALE IN PORCELAIN Exclusive! A 2+1+2 apartment is offered for sale in the Porcelani area of ​​Gotech. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a 2022 building with an elevator and well-managed. Sip. the total area of ​​the apartment is 102 m2 and it is organized in: corridor, two bedrooms, living room with kitchen area, two toilets, balcony. The orientation of the apartment is east. The property is sold furnished as in the photo and is an ideal opportunity for both residence and investment. Possibility of purchase for two parking spaces at an extra price. Has regular mortgage documentation. For more information or assistance in the property, please contact us.
